topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Well, would you look at that! My old eyes ain't so bad, spotting such a glint in all this dust. Found this ring, finely wrought, in the pawn shop. It's a bit tarnished, but still holds a shine. Reminds me of the one my grandmother had, before she gave it to my mother, and now it's lost, or so we thought. Maybe this is a sign, one of those rare good omens to come from the heavens. It's not just a piece of metal and stone, but a piece of memory, of love long past. I'll clean it up, maybe pass it along. The saints surely smile down on days like these.
